messages:
neha: Created a consolidation PR to unify 429 + context-limit troubleshooting sections and add migration steps for clients that hit token windows. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301. Need: SDK code snippets (python/js), a tiny e2e repro, anchor redirects, and a short explainer for trimming strategies.

oliver: I can take anchor redirects and the explainer on trimming heuristics. We should recommend server-side prefix preservation pattern (keep system messages and truncate user history). I'll draft examples.

pablo: taking JS and TS snippets for the SDK. Thinking of showing: 1) detect 431/429-like payload-too-large, 2) call a `trimContext()` helper, 3) retry with Retry-After handling. Will include comments about conservative backoff.

zoe: I'll add the tiny e2e — a docker-compose dev stack and a one-liner load script that toggles rate limits. Also can add a smoke test workflow in .github/workflows/docs-429-check.yml.

ci-bot: Lint check: docs/troubleshooting.md: md-list-indent: inconsistent indentation at line 78

neha: Thanks, CI. I'll fix formatting. @pablo please include both fetch and node-fetch examples; some customers still use fetch in node. Also include a snippet showing parsing both string and HTTP-date forms of Retry-After.

pablo: pushed initial JS snippet, includes:
```js
// pseudo-snippet: handle Retry-After
const resp = await fetch(url, opts);
if (resp.status === 429) {
  const ra = resp.headers.get('retry-after');
  const wait = parseRetryAfter(ra) || Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(2, attempts), 30000);
  await sleep(wait);
  return retryRequest();
}
```
I'll add a tiny `parseRetryAfter` util that supports seconds and HTTP-date.

oliver: for trimming heuristics doc: recommend three levels: 1) immediate trim (drop oldest user messages), 2) prefix-preserve (keep system + last N turns), 3) policy clip (drop heavy embeddings/attachments). Add a short diagram and quick code sketch.

zoe: docker-compose + curl load script snippet:
```bash
# run dev server
docker-compose up -d dev-server
# hit server repeatedly to trigger rate limit
for i in $(seq 1 200); do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:8080/generate || break; sleep 0.05; done
```
This reliably produces some 429s when dev RPS cap is low.

neha: Perfect. Let's also add an example of graceful fallback to a smaller model variant when token window or rate limit errors occur. Maybe a short flowchart: primary -> fallback-small -> queued retry.

pablo: added node+fetch+undici variants and a TS typings example. Left comments for SDK team about aligning helper names (we have both `RetryHelper` and `retryRequest` floating around).

oliver: pushed PR update with anchor redirects mapping file (redirects.json) that maps old anchors to new ones. Also added editorial note on how we keep stable anchor slugs.

ci-bot: Build passed for markdown lint, but link-checker reported 2 broken external links (line 142 and 201).

neha: I'll replace external links with archived copies or PR to upstream docs. Assigned follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/795

zoe: pushed the GitHub Actions workflow for docs-429-smoke as draft. It runs the curl script and reports failures as annotations. Set to manual trigger for now.

neha: Anything blocking merge? I'm resolving comments and will squash. We should include a short note in the changelog about redirect behavior.

pablo: small nit: add code fence with `node` and `python` language tags for better rendering.

neha: will do. Merging later today after CI is green and infra confirms the docs workflow won't spam alerts.

infra-bot: Note: docs workflows that hit dev infra should use the `docs` team token with limited scopes. Please create a scoped token if not present.

neha: @infra-bot opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/412 to request docs token. Assigning to infra oncall.

oliver: After merge, can we add a short customer-facing blurb in console release notes pointing to the troubleshooting guide? Feels like this will help reduce support tickets.

neha: agree. I'll draft a short blurb and add to next release notes. Thanks all for quick turnaround.
